name: Anu LMS
description: Deceptively simple learning management system (LMS) for individual teachers, educational organisations and businesses, with a progressively decoupled React front end.
project_description:
Anu LMS is a deceptively simple Drupal learning management system (LMS) for individual teachers, educational organisations and businesses. It was developed to provide engaging and impactful learning experience for students, with a UX based on extensive research. Its UI is powered by a progressively decoupled React application and comes alongside with the module.

 Back to top 

 Live examples 
 To get a high level understanding of Anu LMS look & feel you are welcome to visit one of the examples listed below. Note that each of these examples is just a particular use case of Anu LMS tailored to the project's specific needs and therefore does not demonstrate all possible capabilities of the module.

 Features 
 
 Designed to create learning content separated into courses, modules, lessons and quizzes 
 Rich content editorial capabilities, including support of audio files, video embeds, checklists, tables, resource downloads, etc. 
 Linear lesson progress (i.e. access to Lesson B is given when Lesson A is completed) 
 Linear course progress (i.e. access to Course B is given when Course A is fully completed) 
 Questions and answers alongside the lessons content (for self-checks) 
 Quizzes at the end of modules (for knowledge checks) 
 Flexible permissions to access learning content per organisation (requires Group ) 
 Search (requires Search API ) 
 Works offline (requires PWA ) 
 Multilingual support (including right-to-left languages)
